tools.description: Look up free appointment slots on a given date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the list of free slots.
tools.name: check_availability

tools.description: Book a free slot. Requires name, phone (10 digits), date (YYYY-MM-DD) and time (HH:MM 24h). Fails if the slot is taken or does not exist. No double-booking.
tools.name: book_slot

tools.description: Record a message for the shop owner when the caller wants to leave one.
tools.name: take_message

tools.description: Record an SMS-style confirmation for a completed booking. NOTE: this only records the confirmation in confirmations.json and reads it aloud; no real SMS is sent (offline build).
tools.name: send_confirmation
